subject: How many concurrent users can a shiny app handle?

messages.author: f73ca098f30ec443
messages.subject: How many concurrent users can a shiny app handle?
parts:
Hello,

My company is looking to build an analytics dashboard for a large investment management firm. shinyapps.io platform seemed attractive for this purpose. But before we bet our time and resources on shinyapps.io platform, we wish to get a sense of how well the platform will scale with the number of users. We are looking to signup for the Professional tier. The documentation says that the Professional tier provides up to 10 application instances or virtualized servers. Each application instance can run multiple 'Workers', and each Worker services multiple end-users. But it is unclear how many concurrent users could be supported at any given time by an application running on the Professional tier. We are looking to scale up to 30,000 end users who will be limited access by user authentication.
Is there currently another shiny app running on the platform that supports high concurrent usage? Could you give us a sense of how many concurrent users it supports?

Thank you.
Nitin
